source: Observed on XyceNF 7.10.0 with -namesfile, -norun and .dc runs (xm4-tasks 5.1 point 11; decision 0031 item 5), against the Xyce Reference Guide 7.10 §2.3.17 p241–243 (Q), §2.3.18 p286 (J), §2.3.19 p290 (Z), §2.3.20 p292–296 (M), Table 2-102 p326 (TNODEOUT). The manual agrees except that it gives MEXTRAM level 504 five nodes and level 505 four (manual-error). By element class, then LEVEL: `nodes` is the range of node counts Xyce takes, `tnodeout` the range when the line sets TNODEOUT=, and `extra` what Xyce does with more nodes than the range allows: `dropped` (silently), `joined` (to an internal node of the device: a different circuit) or `stops`. It is left out where it was not observed: Q level 504, and the levels whose range reaches the count by letter that the grammar allows. Fewer nodes than the range always stop Xyce. A model without LEVEL is level 1 (`default_level`).
